:::{#thm-conditional-mean-precision}
#### The conditional mean of one element from the precision matrix

Let $\vX \sim \Normal_p\paren{\vecf{\mean}, \matr{\covmat}}$ with $p \ge 2$,
let $\vX_{-i}$ be $\vX$ without its $i$th element,
and let $\vx_{-i}$ be a fixed value of $\vX_{-i}$.
Then

$$
\condE{X_i}{\vX_{-i} = \vx_{-i}}
= \mean_i - \sum_{j \ne i} \frac{\precision(\vX)_{ij}}{\precision(\vX)_{ii}} \paren{x_j - \mean_j},
$$

and $\condVar{X_i}{\vX_{-i} = \vx_{-i}} = 1 / \precision(\vX)_{ii}$,
where $\precision(\vX)$ is the [precision matrix](#def-precision-matrix) of $\vX$.

:::

::: proof

Reordering the elements of $\vX$ reorders the [rows](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-matrices.html#def-matrix) and [columns](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-matrices.html#def-matrix) of $\matr{\covmat}$ and of $\precision(\vX)$ in the same way,
so we may take $X_i$ to be the last element.
Cut $\vX$, $\vecf{\mean}$ and $\matr{\covmat}$ into blocks with $\vX_{-i}$ first and $X_i$ last,
as in @thm-mvn-conditional with $\vX_1 = \vX_{-i}$ and $\vX_2 = X_i$,
and let $\matr{S} = \matr{\covmat}_{22} - \matr{\covmat}_{21}\inv{\matr{\covmat}_{11}}\matr{\covmat}_{12}$.
By @thm-mvn-conditional,
the conditional mean and variance of $X_i$ given $\vX_{-i} = \vx_{-i}$ are

$$
\mean_i + \matr{\covmat}_{21}\inv{\matr{\covmat}_{11}}\paren{\vx_{-i} - \vecf{\mean}_{-i}}
\quad \text{and} \quad
\matr{S}.
$$

By @thm-precision-matrix-inverse, $\precision(\vX) = \inv{\matr{\covmat}}$,
and by [the inverse of a positive definite block matrix](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-diagonalization.html#thm-block-inverse),
its blocks $\matr{\Omega}_{21}$ and $\matr{\Omega}_{22}$ satisfy

$$
\matr{\Omega}_{22} = \inv{\matr{S}},
\quad
\matr{\Omega}_{21} = -\inv{\matr{S}}\matr{\covmat}_{21}\inv{\matr{\covmat}_{11}}.
$$

Here $\matr{\Omega}_{22} = \precision(\vX)_{ii}$ is a scalar,
so the conditional variance is $\matr{S} = 1 / \precision(\vX)_{ii}$,
and multiplying the second equation by $\matr{S}$ gives

$$
\ba
\matr{\covmat}_{21}\inv{\matr{\covmat}_{11}}
&= -\matr{S}\matr{\Omega}_{21}
&& \text{(multiply by } \matr{S} \text{)} \\
&= -\frac{\matr{\Omega}_{21}}{\precision(\vX)_{ii}}.
&& \text{(} \matr{S} = 1 / \precision(\vX)_{ii} \text{)}
\ea
$$

The elements of $\matr{\Omega}_{21}$ are $\precision(\vX)_{ij}$ for $j \ne i$,
so the conditional mean is

$$
\mean_i - \sum_{j \ne i} \frac{\precision(\vX)_{ij}}{\precision(\vX)_{ii}} \paren{x_j - \mean_j}.
$$

:::
